concepts.quote: Add v to sum first, then check if it was negative and subtract it again.
concepts.why: The answer treats sum as a running total that is updated per value (add, then undo for negatives) — a valid alternative for the sum — but it never traces this code's values, never gives the output asked for, and ignores count, so it only shows the accumulator role, not its application to this code.
The answer says nothing about count++ or any ++/-- operator.
The answer never names += or -= nor states any rule about compound assignment; 'add v to sum' is only a plain-language description of the update.
